question.decision_use: Decide whether to route a manager inspection after a water-presence alert without declaring its extent or actuating a physical control.

claim.text: The identified north-corridor water pad produced a current active observation.

observation_paths.sampling_or_trigger: on state change plus five-minute health pulse
observation_paths.expected_continuity: one health pulse every five minutes
observation_paths.gap_detection: two missing health pulses mark the observation path stale
observation_paths.transport_semantics: fictional MQTT application message with retained flag and native packet metadata preserved
observation_paths.queue_or_overflow: broker queue state recorded; no completeness claim extends beyond the recorded path

observation_paths.gap_detection: a minute without a covering observation opens a gap

decision_gate.admission_rule: Route a bounded inspection packet only when PAD-03 identity, lifecycle, source time, health pulse, native quality, and receipt deadline pass.
decision_gate.degradation_rule: If PAD-03 health is stale, identity conflicts, or quality is not good, mark the claim indeterminate and route the accountable manager without declaring a dry or wet facility state.

privacy.purpose: Fictional property-protection incident triage for one bounded corridor observation.
privacy.retention_rule: Fictional thirty-day observation retention subject to accountable-owner review.

evidence_boundary: Fictional teaching record for structural conformance only; it proves no facility, device, water condition, model capability, deployment, privacy compliance, safety result, customer outcome, or operating performance.
